text:
dev_jules: FYI CI turned red on main after the toolchain bump, macOS build failing on //third_party/objc:objc_runtime. logs attached.

ci-bot: Build failed (macos-clang): //third_party/objc:objc_runtime — exit status 1

dev_jules: here's the head of the log:
```
clang: error: no such file or directory: '/usr/local/opt/llvm/lib/clang/12.0.0/include/objc/objc.h'
In file included from ...
```

samir: @dev_jules can you bisect? last green was 3 commits ago (commit 8a1f2...). Might be toolchain image change.

dev_jules: starting `git bisect` between 8a1f2..f3b9c — will log results. pinging @oncall_ash in case infra image needs rollback.

oncall_ash: oncall here, checking image tags. We rolled clang 12.0.0->13.1 yesterday for linux; mac image upgrade slipped. Investigating. :mag: 

laura: adding info: mac sandbox paths changed in the new base image — headers moved to /opt/llvm/include/objc. Maybe Bazel toolchain path wasn't updated.

samir: try adding `--action_env=CPATH=/opt/llvm/include` to the CI job as a quick workaround.

dev_jules: tried that locally, partial progress but still fails at linker: missing -ObjC symbols. full rerun queued: CI rerun #1778.

infra_bot: Rerun started by @dev_jules — https://ci.internal/1778 :eyes:

ci-bot: Rerun finished: still failing on same target. Log: ```
Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
  "objc_storeStrong", referenced from:...
```

laura: ok this looks like runtime libs mismatch. @oncall_ash can you check that /opt/llvm/lib is on the mac runner loader path or that the toolchain installs the right runtime?

oncall_ash: mac runners don't use LD_LIBRARY_PATH, native dyld looks at @rpath. I'll try a temporary image revert and patch the toolchain config.

dev_jules: bisect status: good=8a1f2 bad=f3b9c. narrowed to commit f2ab45 which changed mac toolchain symlink behavior. pushing bisect log to the ticket and the PR.

samir: can someone file an eng-infra ticket? I'll attach the bisect output and CI link.

dev_jules: filed ticket INFRA-462 with bisect output + CI links. also added a short workaround in the CI job to set CPATH for now. dropping a note in #eng-oncall. :wave:
